title: Mark a task done in a SQLite app DB
instruction: In data/tasks.db mark the task titled 'File taxes' as done (done=1). Do not add or remove rows.

data/tasks.db: CREATE TABLE tasks (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
INSERT INTO tasks (title, done) VALUES ('Buy milk', 1)
INSERT INTO tasks (title, done) VALUES ('File taxes', 0)
INSERT INTO tasks (title, done) VALUES ('Call mom', 0)

getter.sql: SELECT done FROM tasks WHERE title = ?
SELECT title FROM tasks WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id
